transform.sign_storage: int8 vector of input width, shared across cold experts per layer/projection
transform.runtime_uses: serialized signs; seed is conversion provenance only
transform.scope: cold linear projections only; separate gate/up and down transforms; no transform through SwiGLU
transform.tp_constraint: transform blocks may not cross a down-projection rank boundary

weight_encoding.index_layout: existing native ARVQ MMA fragment layout, 15 packed bits per vector

activation_encoding.hot_routes: skip rotation and retain original NVFP4 packing

deployment.requires: re-encoded cold weights and transform-aware loader/packer dispatch
